title: Exclude coupled star callers at every length and port rank
body:
This **scoped negative result** excludes the constant-loss star query frame at every odd leaf count g>=3, every coupled port rank, and every call order in the declared characteristic-two model. Coupling ports cannot repair this frame. **Complete kappa is unchanged.** A 2050-call relaxed profile passes the complete PR5599 price screen at saving 1/320, but this theorem prevents its required operator.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f12b6bef1e25f649bd62edae36cd144fe19899/research/longer-coupled-port-caller/PROOF.md), [exact result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f12b6bef1e25f649bd62edae36cd144fe19899/research/longer-coupled-port-caller/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f12b6bef1e25f649bd62edae36cd144fe19899/research/longer-coupled-port-caller/SOURCES.json), and [independent certificate checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/67f12b6bef1e25f649bd62edae36cd144fe19899/research/longer-coupled-port-caller/check_certificates.py) are pinned to `67f12b6bef1e25f649bd62edae36cd144fe19899`.

The new step reduces any length to three good stages and four connector queries. All 75,600 relative order types have explicit identities in a free noncommutative algebra: 72,020 have degree at most two, and 3,580 have degree at most three. Each identity expands to 1 from equations that a caller would have to satisfy. Evaluation in matrices proves the exclusion at every dimension; this is not a finite matrix-size census. The largest witness has 77 terms, and the complete compressed certificate is 108,057 bytes. The checker does not import the discovery code or use a solver.

The contract fixes the grouped star query maps and four complementary connector queries. Every compatible coupled split of each full-rank good stage is allowed. Other query frames, connector maps, interleaved additional queries, nonfull stage ranks, noninvolutive stages, helper feedback and general complex/dyadic callers remain outside the theorem. No native admission or reduction from arbitrary complex programs is claimed.

Verification uses Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/longer-coupled-port-caller
python3.12 -I -O -B research/longer-coupled-port-caller/verify.py
```

Expected result: `PASS_ALL_ORDER_COUPLED_STAR_EXCLUSION`, followed by `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` for the registered command. Normal and optimized local replays pass and match byte for byte. Checks include 24 coupled frames, 96 literal mixed coefficients, 206 symbolic matrix blocks, 432 three-leaf restrictions, a genuine one-leaf full word, 1,365 parity controls and corrupted-witness/query controls. Committed-byte and export inventory checks pass. The read-only, Git-free optimized export passes with PATH=/nonexistent and matches the result byte for byte. A changed invoice is rejected before computation and is then restored. Native replay, proof-assistant verification and independent human review are not part of this claim.

Hosted CI [run 40258944381](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40258944381) stops in the shared planner on two selected-record navigation tests: the Current CI section lacks the new review and source-manifest links. The package replay job is skipped. This is the upstream main navigation failure reported in Discussion1200; the local and Git-free passes above are separate evidence.

The branch starts at canonical main `6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63`. The refresh at `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c` moved the selected result upstream to .00310045 without changing the priority or working instructions. This PR does not edit the selected record.

Material predecessors are [PR #5617](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5617) at `6c088037e13b87faf7cfe3233c53d0ae51850dd8` for the rank/intersection cuts, [PR #5631](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5631) at `533a5f463e89e6fb74287ffe93c815fe83da10bb` for the star frame and mixed chronology equation, and [PR #5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599) at `09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137` for the complete local bill. Credit Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 for the controller and simplex lineage, and all retained P104, helper, native, compiler and outer-framework authors. Free-algebra identities and linear algebra are standard tools; the coupled-frame reduction and its all-order certificates are the new application.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5593#discussioncomment-19186880). Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. The saved discovery programs and exact proof format support a next search with a different frame or connector contract.
